tiktok.title: 1. 📊 Create a Budget Give every shilling a purpose before you spend it. Track your income and expenses monthly. 2. 💵 Pay Yourself First Save at least 10% of every income before spending on anything else. 3. 🏦 Separate Savings from Spending Keep your savings in a different account or savings platform to reduce temptation. 4. ☕ Reduce Small Daily Expenses Small purchases such as snacks, soft drinks, and impulse buys add up over time. 5. 📝 Differentiate Needs from Wants Buy what you need first and delay non-essential purchases. 6. 🛒 Plan Before You Shop Make a list and stick to it to avoid impulse spending. 7. 📱 Limit Lifestyle Inflation As your income grows, avoid increasing your spending at the same rate. 8. 🚫 Avoid Unnecessary Debt Borrow only when it creates value or generates income. 9. 🎯 Set Clear Savings Goals Save for specific objectives such as land, a business, education, emergencies, or investments. 10. 📈 Turn Savings Into Investments Don't just save; invest wisely so your money can grow over time. 🌱 Wealth Principle "It is not how much you earn that determines your future, but how much you keep and how wisely you grow it."
